title: On Generalized Chebyshev polynomials
summary: In this paper, we introduce and study a novel family of generalized Chebyshev polynomials defined via a rational generating function. We demonstrate that the classical Chebyshev polynomials of the first, second, third, and fourth kinds naturally emerge as special cases of this framework. Furthermore, we derive comprehensive recurrence relations, tridiagonal determinant representations, and explicit closed-form expressions for these polynomials.
